view.title: ANC4 Coverage: Gaya vs Nalanda, 2021–2023
view.note: Each line shows the share of registered pregnancies that completed four antenatal checkups. The table below lists the underlying counts and the calculated coverage rate for each district and year.

insight_specs.message: This file contains only counts of registered pregnancies and completed checkups by district and year. It has no information on facility access, staffing, transport, community awareness, or any other factor that could explain why one district outperforms another. The data can show that a gap exists and how large it is, but it cannot explain the cause.

insights.label: What this data cannot answer
insights.text: This file shows differences and changes, but it has no explanatory variables and cannot establish why they occurred.

source.provenance: Deterministic synthetic district-level ANC fixture created for the benchmark; no people or sensitive records. District names are illustrative and values are not official statistics.
